meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 仍然是主控，但可以通过 MCP 工具调用本地 Atomic Chat 桌面应用中的模型。Claude 可以列出可用模型，并将提示发送给指定模型生成回复。
howto.when: 当用户提到“Atomic Chat”、“原子聊天”或要求使用本地模型时，Claude 会触发相应的工具。也可以明确要求使用 atomic_chat_generate 工具。

say.text: 用 Atomic Chat 列出可用模型，然后选一个回答：法国的首都是什么？
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型，再生成回答。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude remains the orchestrator but can use MCP tools to call local models from the Atomic Chat desktop app. Claude can list available models and send prompts to a specified model for generating responses.
howto.when_en: When the user mentions "Atomic Chat", "atomic chat", or asks to use a local model, Claude triggers the relevant tools. It can also be triggered by explicitly requesting the atomic_chat_generate tool.

say_en.text: Use Atomic Chat to list available models, then pick one to answer: What is the capital of France?
say_en.note: Claude will list models first, then generate an answer.

say_en.text: Use atomic_chat_generate tool with model llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: How big is the Sun?
say_en.note: Directly request generation from the specified model.
